summary.tldr: Amends 51 federal laws to fit Quebec civil law and to make both language versions reflect common law and civil law.
what_it_does: Amends 51 federal statutes to harmonize federal law with the civil law of Quebec.
Updates financial laws, including the Bank Act, Cooperative Credit Associations Act, Insurance Companies Act and Trust and Loan Companies Act.
Updates other laws, including the Access to Information Act, Financial Administration Act, Interpretation Act and Official Languages Act.
Ensures each language version of the amended laws takes into account both common law and civil law.
who_it_affects: People and businesses using federal laws in Quebec
Users of federal laws in English and French
summary.background: This is the fourth in a series of bills linked to the harmonisation of federal statutes after the Civil Code of Québec came into force in 1994.
